page.layout: Two engraved coin medallions at the top, side by side, with their legends around the rims. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. The signature sits under the text. A woodcut tailpiece ornament sits at the foot. No marginal notes and no catchword.

main_text.p: LIBUSSA, Craci, secundi Bohemiae Regis filia, aliquot annos principatum tenuit: tandem cum litem aliquam, quanquam iure ac recte definiisset, attamen qui causa ceciderat, humi procumbens, clamavit, indigne viros a foemina gubernari: accurrens multitudo Regem postulat. Quare haec Primislao agricolae, nescio quo modo (vel quod sic collibuerit, vel forte quadam) nupsit, qui Bohemos rexit, & Pragam primus aggere & muro cinxit circiter annum mundi 5165. a Christo nato 1123. Videto Chronographiam Ioannis Naucleri, generatione trigesimanona.

VALASCA, una quidem ex puellis Libussae, ingentis animi & generosi, Amazonicae gentis virgo, mortua Libussa, accersiuit mulieres ac virgines, quas his verbis compellavit: Heram perdidimus, quae non passa est nos viris subiici: adeste mihi, & ego vobis imperium polliceor: coniurant in viros singulae, quos obvios habent ex improviso trucidant: armatae postea, bella multa feliciter conficiunt, virorum semper victrices: & more Amazonum viuere statuunt. Tandem vero Primislai dolo & insidiis captae, omnes ad internecionem usque mactantur. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Two coin engravings at the top, not transcribed as text. Left coin legend: "GOTH. REG" on the left rim and "LIBVSSA" on the right rim. Right coin legend: "VALASCA" on the left rim and "BOHE" on the right rim. Woodcut tailpiece ornament at the foot, with a figure in its centre. Spelling as printed where legible; u/v and long s normalised per the rules. The printed "Craci" and "Videto" are as printed.
